title: Criminal Complaint under Section 138 read with Section 142 NI Act, 1881 & Section 223 BNSS, 2023
whenToUse: Use when filing formal criminal complaint before Metropolitan Magistrate or Judicial Magistrate First Class following non-compliance with Section 138 15-day statutory demand notice.
variantComparisonNote: Originating criminal complaint following dishonour notice. Distinct from pre-litigation notice 'ni_act_sec138_dishonour_notice' and civil summary suit under Order XXXVII CPC.
youWillNeed: Original dishonoured cheque, bank return memo, copy of statutory notice, speed post receipt & tracking report, Section 63 BSA certificate.
legalBasis: Sections 138, 141, 142 Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 read with Section 223 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS); Section 143A NI Act.
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Cheque drawn towards discharge of legally enforceable debt or liability
Presentation of cheque within 3 months validity period
Cheque returned unpaid with return memo
Statutory notice issued within 30 days of memo receipt
Failure of accused to pay within 15 days of notice receipt
Complaint filed within 1 month of cause of action under Section 142(1)(b)

particulars.label: Seat of Magistrate Court
particulars.description: City or District seat of jurisdiction

particulars.label: Complainant Name
particulars.description: Full legal name of Payee / Complainant

aiBlocks.title: Commercial Transaction & Debt Incurrence
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft exhaustive factual background describing commercial dealing, consideration, issuance of cheque and subsisting legally enforceable liability.

aiBlocks.title: Presentation, Dishonour & Statutory Notice
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Detail statutory dates of presentation, return memo with dishonour reason, dispatch and service of 15-day statutory demand notice.

aiBlocks.title: Cause of Action, Limitation & Prayer
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Detail cause of action accrual under Section 138(c), compliance with Section 142 limitation, and prayer for process issuance, maximum penalty and 20% interim compensation under Section 143A.
